summary.headline: Judging Life, Death, and Illness
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging survival or death from the lords of the houses of life and death, malefics, fortunes, reception, and disposition. An example then examines Saturn as lord of the house of infirmity and Venus separating from Saturn to signify the disease’s diminution.
